# Requirements Quality Checklist: 挂载丢失自动恢复 (Mount Loss Auto-Recovery)

**Purpose**: 在进入任务分解前，验证挂载丢失自动恢复特性规格的需求书写质量（完整性、清晰度、一致性、可测性、场景与边界覆盖、依赖假设）
**Created**: 2026-10-05
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `$speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.
**Focus/Depth**: 全维度标准 + 标准评审深度（维护者 2026-10-05 拍板：Q1=A 全维度，Q2=A 标准评审）。

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are all outcomes of “卷缺失/失效分类” requirements defined, including the unknown-signal conservative fallback? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002 ①–④, §FR-010]
- [x] CHK002 Are the recovery trigger sources fully enumerated（登录 / 网络配置变化 / 挂载命名空间变化）with the explicit no-periodic constraint? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009]
- [x] CHK003 Is the configuration switch behavior specified for both states (默认启用；关闭后回落基线；手动入口仍可用)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008]
- [x] CHK004 Are state persistence requirements documented (按卷粒度、边界绑定、可丢弃重建)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-010, §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK005 Are the notification and manual-remount fallback requirements specified for both failure and suppression cases? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007, §US3]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK006 Is “会话级抑制” quantified with an exact release boundary（网络上下文变化或重新登录，先到者为准）? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004]
- [x] CHK007 Is the recovery timing criterion clarified as “事件唤醒后的当轮评估内、不设钟表时限” rather than a vague “尽快”? [Clarity, Spec §SC-001, Clarifications 2026-10-05]
- [x] CHK008 Are “健康时弹出”与“修复性弹出”由可观察条件区分，而非依赖不可读的意图表述? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003; Contract §2 信号 3/6]
- [x] CHK009 Is “有界重试”的边界在需求中有明确数值或显式委托引用（而非无限定的“有限次”）? [Measurability, Spec §FR-005; Contract §3]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK010 Do US2 的抑制场景与 FR-004 的边界语义完全一致、无相互矛盾? [Consistency, Spec §用户故事2 / §FR-004]
- [x] CHK011 Are the “禁周期轮询”“不提供弹出功能”两条边界在 spec、plan、contract 三处表述一致? [Consistency, Spec §FR-009 / §排除边界; plan.md; Contract §1–2]
- [x] CHK012 Does SC-003 的零打扰指标集与 FR-005/FR-006 的要求一一对应、无遗漏或冲突? [Consistency, Spec §SC-003 / §FR-005 / §FR-006]
- [x] CHK013 Are FR-002 的信号分类与 data-model 状态机的状态一一映射、命名无冲突? [Consistency, Spec §FR-002; data-model.md §4]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK014 Are SC-001…SC-005 全部具备客观通过/失败阈值（100%、0 次、可验证项）? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001–005]
- [x] CHK015 Is SC-002 的“0 次红线”观测窗口（本可达会话）无歧义、可判定? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
- [x] CHK016 Is the acceptance-evidence rule（实机真实挂载 + 伪终端标注、隔离不作挂载语义证据）stated where it governs SC-001/SC-002? [Traceability, Spec §Clarifications / §Assumptions]

## Scenario Coverage

- [x] CHK017 Are Primary（丢挂载恢复）、Alternate（修复弹出）、Exception（恢复失败→兜底）、Recovery（边界解禁后恢复）四类场景均有验收场景? [Coverage, Spec §用户故事1–3]
- [x] CHK018 Are requirements defined for the “recovery repeatedly fails” journey（通知去重、不轰炸）? [Coverage, Spec §用户故事3 AC3, §FR-007]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK019 Are edge cases documented for 长时间离线、凭据失效、睡眠唤醒、状态损坏、挂载点历史污染、零事件角落与恢复中手动挂载? [Edge Case, Spec §边界与异常情况处理]
- [x] CHK020 Is the zero-event corner's conservative behavior explicitly bounded（推迟而非静默丢弃）? [Edge Case, Spec §边界与异常情况处理]
- [x] CHK021 Is concurrent user action during recovery（同一卷手动挂载、恢复后再次弹出）addressed as idempotency/new-suppression requirements? [Edge Case, Spec §边界与异常情况处理, §FR-005]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [x] CHK022 Are process-model constraints（无常驻等待进程、无固定周期唤醒）stated as verifiable non-functional requirements? [Non-Functional, Spec §FR-009, §SC-005]
- [x] CHK023 Are state-file security requirements specified（无凭据、非活动配置、0600、程序独占、可丢弃）? [Non-Functional, Contract §6; data-model.md §1]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [x] CHK024 Are dependencies on existing capabilities（主机探活、静默挂载、钥匙串、通知）与待新建能力（网络身份判定等）及 pending 对照实验的批准时机 documented as assumptions? [Dependency, Spec §Assumptions; research.md §8]

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied.
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation.

## 评审记录 (Review Record)

**评审日期**: 2026-10-06 | **结论**: 24/24 通过（门禁开启，可进入实现阶段） | **评审方式**: 多轮无上下文独立子代理评审 + 维护者授权下的逐条查证

- **第 1 轮**: 两份独立评审均判 FAIL。有效发现：CHK002 所引 `FR-009` 未枚举触发源（`挂载命名空间` 在 spec 中出现 0 次，而 T007/T022 却要实现它——属需求真空而非引用笔误）；CHK011 所引 `plan.md` 未声明“不提供弹出功能”边界。
- **第 2–4 轮**: 每轮由两份无上下文评审复核，逐项修复并复验。修正项包括：FR-009 补三类触发源；plan.md 补边界声明；FR-002 补 ④（从未挂载的启用卷不进抑制）；新增持久字段 `everHealthyMounted` 使 ③/④ 可判别；FR-010 明确“文件不存在 ≠ 状态损坏”；data-model §4 增信号→状态映射表；contract §2 扩为六行；“可达会话/边界变化判据”定为可判定；SC-004 改为可观测计数；SC-002 特性前基线与“未验证”如实标注；通知补会话级上限；任务侧修正悬空引用、`[P]` 误标、Phase 6 顺序自相矛盾、`InstallState.healIfNeeded` 符号名、`import SystemConfiguration`/钥匙串能力表述、以及 T024 与 T023 的 Esc 语义冲突。
- **第 6 轮（终审）**: 一份只读评审 24/24 PASS，另一份只读评审 TASKS GATE PASS；两者均确认前述两处阻断项已真实闭合。
- **如实声明**: 本清单的通过是**需求书写质量**层面的结论，不代表实现完成。SC-001/SC-002/SC-004 的实机对照实验仍待维护者批准时机（T018/T019）；卸载侧（健康弹出的干净卸载形状）与 `StartOnMount` 触发行为仍属未验证项，已在 spec §Assumptions 与 T018 中标注。
